newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-JAPAN COMPLETE KIRIN CUP HAT-TRICK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JAPAN COMPLETE KIRIN CUP HAT-TRICK.

text.p: Japan won the Kirin Cup soccer tournament for the third consecutive year when they beat Turkey 1-0 in Osaka on Sunday.
Cerezo Osaka midfielder Hiroaki Morishima scored the decisive goal in the first half, tapping in a deflection off a Turkish defender.
Goalkeeper Yoshikatsu Kawaguchi saved a spot kick early in the second half at Nagai stadium to preserve the narrow advantage.
Japan ended the round-robin competition with two victories and no defeats, after beating Croatia 4-3 last week in Tokyo.
Croatia and Turkey both ended with one draw and one loss, with Croatia being awarded second place on goal difference.
